summary: Kent County tower; register says first operated 1926, moved to a Cranston correctional facility in 1973 as a guard tower, while another source dates it to 1934.

facts.status_note: Gone from the hill. The register says it was moved to the Adult Correction Institution in Cranston and used there as a guard tower; a separate Cranston ACI list entry is marked gone.
facts.agency: Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: (1) build date: FFLOS says first operated 1926; the Forest Lookouts page quotes a 1934 federal work-project line. The same 1934 line also appears on other RI Forest Lookouts pages, so it may be a generic programme note rather than a record specific to this tower; not confirmed. (2) Status: FFLOS says the tower is used as a guard tower at the Cranston Adult Correction Institution, but the Forest Fire Lookout Association list has a separate 'Cranston ACI' entry marked gone. It is not clear whether they are the same structure, so whether a tower stands there today is open. A human should check the ACI site before the status is set. (3) A social-media post (Greater Rhode Island Ruins, Facebook) says the tower was erected in Wickaboxet State Forest in 1934; not used because it is not a citable page. Wikipedia gives the state forest's founding as 1932 and no source links the tower to the forest. (4) Record status 'gone' matches the Wickaboxet Hill entry; no correction proposed. (5) No staffing or fire history found. The access note is deliberately omitted: the tower's current location is a correctional facility and no source describes access.
